title: Don't Cut Corners: How Training Outside the Prior Makes Simulation-Based Inference More Robust
abstract: arXiv:2608.12470v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large astrophysical simulation campaigns often generate training data by sampling parameters across a Uniform prior box. Due to the proposal's sharp edge, neural posterior estimators struggle to learn accurate approximations near the boundaries. We propose Tailed-Uniform, a family of hybrid proposal distributions for sampling training simulations for robust simulation-based inference. By padding the original hard-truncated training box with decaying tails, Tailed-Uniform-trained networks yield more accurate posteriors near and beyond the edges. We demonstrate these improvements on a family of tail shapes, including a widened Uniform box as a control. Our results suggest that additional simulations near the prior boundary better constrain the networks as it approaches the edge of the training box, even for Uniform assumed priors. translated_title: 不要偷工减料：在先验之外训练如何使基于模拟的推断更稳健
translated_abstract: 大型天体物理模拟活动通常通过在均匀先验箱上采样参数来生成训练数据。由于提议分布的尖锐边缘，神经后验估计器在边界附近难以学习到准确的近似。我们提出了Tailed-Uniform，一种用于采样训练模拟的混合提议分布家族，以实现稳健的基于模拟的推断。通过在原始硬截断训练箱上填充衰减尾部，经过Tailed-Uniform训练的网络在边缘附近及之外能产生更准确的后验。我们在多种尾部形状上展示了这些改进，包括作为对照的加宽均匀箱。我们的结果表明，在先验边界附近的额外模拟能更好地约束网络，使其接近训练箱边缘，即使对于均匀假设的先验也是如此。我们在一个玩具问题和来自物质功率谱的宇宙学参数推断中展示了这些优势。
tldr: 通过在训练数据的先验边界外添加衰减尾部，Tailed-Uniform方法显著提升了神经网络在边缘附近及之外的后验推断准确性，增强了基于模拟的推断的稳健性。
en_tdlr: By adding decaying tails beyond the prior boundary in training data, the Tailed-Uniform method significantly improves posterior inference accuracy near and beyond edges, enhancing the robustness of simulation-based inference.
